input: 14 hand-built VCF records on chromosome 21 of the release-116 GRCh37 cache: an intronic SNV, an intergenic SNV, single-base substitutions called synonymous (one lower-case), stop_lost, missense (one with two alternate alleles), start_lost and stop_gained on transcripts of both strands, a deletion, an insertion, a two-base substitution and a missense SNV the score file leaves out
generator: data/ClinPred_tabbed_synthetic.tsv.gz: scripts/fixtures/plugin_score_fixtures.py from variants.vcf, the layout the plugin's documentation prepares (ClinPred.pm:38-44), in the fixture the header line `#chr Start Ref Alt ClinPred_Score`, with fabricated scores, one row per alternate base at every single-base site (the row the plugin must pick beside two it must not), no row at the unscored site, bgzip and tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2 (seed and digests under plugin_fixtures); the file's name is the name the plugin's documentation gives (ClinPred.pm:23), with the word `synthetic` added before the extension to say that the file is made up; json_cache: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl converted from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh37 cache; expected outputs: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus for the manifest's run, and one Ensembl VEP 116.2 container run per format for each flag set from the vep command recorded under its flag_sets entry, the corpus mounted read-only at /work/corpus and the ClinPred plugin read from the container's plugin directory; manifest: scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --include for every record, flag-set, then classify for the manifest's run and each flag set against the committed tree's binary
